title: SB 260 (88R): Relating to confirmation of a voter's residence by a voter registrar.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(other) Sec 1 (amends Election Code 15.051(a)): registrar shall deliver a written residence confirmation notice if (1) the residence address is a commercial post office box or similar location that does not correspond to a residence; (2) on November 30 following a general election the voter's name is not on the suspense list and the voter has not voted in any election during the previous 25 months; or (3) the registrar has any other reason to believe the current residence differs from the registration records.
(other) Sec 2: effective September 1, 2023.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
